source: The Fraternity's own statements of its proper feast (below). The printed Liturgical Ordo & FSSP Directory is still to be read for anything further.
toConfirm: Whether the Chair of St. Peter is kept as the Fraternity's titular (no. 91 item 12.6) or as its patron's feast (item 12.8). The Fraternity describes itself as under the patronage of the Prince of the Apostles, so it is entered as 12.8; the two differ only when both fall with another proper 1st class feast.
Whether the Fraternity has further proper feasts (a founder's, a secondary patron's) in the printed ordo.

The transfer in 2026: 22 February was the 1st Sunday of Lent, so no. 96 moves the feast to Monday 23 February. Neither the seminary's page nor the French district's page shows it; a parish bulletin from Omaha is reported to.

notInTheCalendar.about: Masses the FSSP seminary's 2026 page (fsspolgs.org/liturgical-calendar) prints beside the day's own, most of them also as a commemoration in the feria's row. They are Masses for certain places, offered as alternatives on a 4th class day, and are not entered here. The French district's monthly ordo (fssp.fr/ordo-du-mois) prints a plain feria on 8 May (2020, 2023, 2025), 6 July (2020, 2023), 27 June (2023) and 4 July (2023, 2024), and the Institute of Christ the King lists the 8 May Masses as alternatives to the feria. They belong to the Masses an ordo offers (M7).
